placements.overview: iScale runs a structured placement support track alongside the technical curriculum. It is support and preparation, not a guarantee of employment.
services: Guidance on portfolio and capstone presentation
placements.eligibility: Learners who complete the program requirements, including graded assignments, the capstone project and the required attendance.
placements.hiring_partner_note: The list of active hiring partners changes over time and is shared by a counselor.
placements.salary_note: Salary outcomes depend on prior experience, location, role and interview performance. A counselor can walk you through realistic ranges for your background instead of quoting a single number.
placements.disclaimer: iScale does not promise or guarantee a job, a placement or a specific salary. Placement support is preparation and access to opportunities.
